rows.grounds: instrumental of mūla used for the root mantra in this rite
compound aṣṭa+śata in instrumental indicating count of recitations
accusative object naming the act/result of pervading
optative of kṛ prescribing the ritual action

items.question: What prescribed recitation with the root mantra accomplishes pervasion in this rite?
premises: root mantra is employed as the instrumental means
eight hundred repetitions are specified for the act
pervasion is named as the result to be accomplished
items.inference: By the root mantra counted as eight hundred one should accomplish pervasion.
items.plain_english: With the root mantra, by means of eight hundred, one should accomplish pervasion.

rows.grounds: locative past participial condition marking completion of that nyāsa
locative demonstrative pointing to the excellent nyāsa just done
compound nyāsa+varya in locative naming the supreme placement rite
emphatic particle marking the stated consequence
accusative neuter subject/object scope of sin to be removed
accusative neuter naming what is destroyed
present of praṇaś stating the result of the accomplished nyāsa

items.question: What consequence follows once this excellent placement has been accomplished?
premises: the condition is completion of this excellent placement
all sin is named as the object affected
destruction of sin is stated as the result
items.inference: When this excellent placement is accomplished, indeed all sin is destroyed.
items.plain_english: When this excellent placement has been accomplished, indeed all sin is destroyed.

rows.grounds: compound ātma+vidyā+śiva in instrumental plural naming the principles set
instrumental plural of tattva referring to those principles
compound tattva+nyāsa in accusative naming the placement to be performed
optative of samācar prescribing performance of the principle placement

items.question: By which set of principles should one perform the placement of principles here?
premises: the principles named are self, knowledge, and Śiva principles
those principles are the instrumental means stated
principle placement is prescribed as the action to perform
items.inference: By the principles of self, knowledge, and Śiva one should perform the principle placement.
items.plain_english: By the principles of self, knowledge, and Śiva one should perform the placement of principles.
